Yes, putting "Add to Read later" in that same always-visible "•••" menu feels right — it's becoming the natural home for all the things I do to a single bookmark, so I know where to look. And the two signals it gave me are exactly what I'd want: the "Saved for later" marker on the card so I can tell at a glance it's in my to-read pile, and the little count next to "Read later" on the side so I can see how much is waiting. Clicking "Read later" then showing me just those is the separate pile I asked for.

The one thing I'd want to make sure is there is the way back out. Once I've actually read something, I need to mark it as read or done so it drops off the "Read later" list and the count ticks down — otherwise the pile only ever grows and stops meaning anything. So wherever "Add to Read later" lives, I'd expect a matching "I've read this / remove from Read later" once it's in there. As long as that round-trip works, this is just what I wanted.
